title: 第24章 蔡怡农：“听姐一句劝，这里面水很深”
content_zh:
第24章 蔡怡农：“听姐一句劝，这里面水很深”-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

2005年，随着《仙剑奇侠传》大火，唐人正式将工作重心转移到内地。

唐人总部设置在魔都普驼区。

下午两点的太阳正烈，一辆浅绿色的锦江出租车“吱呀”停在园区铁门前，车身上“锦江出租”的白色字样有些模糊。

魏沐攥着车门把手挪下来，左手下意识揉着胸口。

“师傅，你这开车水平不赖。”

“还行，开了十几年。”

关上车门，魏沐有点想吐。

魔都的老司机都这么猛？原本20分钟的路程，特娘的12分就开到。

一路上颠来颠去，差点让他吐在车上。

回过神，看了眼四周。

这是一片由旧厂房改造的园区，原为魔都第四纺织机械厂旧址，2000年后改成了创意产业园区。

这地方聚集了大量艺术工作室。

魏沐照着手机上的地址走过去，依稀能看见红砖墙面上还残留着当年纺织机械厂的印记。

不一会，到了地方。

这次过来面试，魏沐已经想好说辞。

现在签约唐人不是一个好的选择，但唐人的电视剧可以演。

唐人马上要开拍的《仙剑奇侠传三》是2009年播出的爆款剧。

男主不用想，必定是胡哥。

无胡歌不仙剑的口号不是说说的。

后世拍摄《仙剑奇侠传5》，男主韩东君娜扎。

项目立项的时候，这两位当时都是新人。

娜扎还好，韩东君可被骂惨了。

有些脑残粉叫嚣“只要男主角不是胡哥，就不看仙剑”

基本从头骂到尾。

电视剧播出以后数据还行，可惜口碑稀烂，再过几年根本没什么讨论度。

相比起来，它的前两部作品后续影响力惊人。

就说一个，后世胡哥刘一菲只要同框，必定有吃瓜群众刷“逍遥哥哥和灵儿”

实际上呢，俩人根本没有猫腻。

拍《仙剑奇侠传一》的时候，刘一菲才多大？

不到17岁，老胡能做什么？

或者说，他敢做什么？

就算有心思，刘晓丽也不会让他得逞，拍戏的时候这位“好母亲”可是一直跟着，不给任何人接近自己女儿的机会。

还有《仙剑奇侠传三》，几个女主角凭借这部戏吃了不少流量。

十几年后，只要这三位没有通告可以刷，那就一起拍个照片发个微博朋友圈啥的，保准上热搜。

In 2005, with the popularity of "Legend of Sword and Fairy", Tangren officially shifted its focus to the mainland.

The headquarters of the Tang Dynasty is located in Putuo District, the magical capital.

The sun was shining brightly at two o'clock in the afternoon. A light green Jinjiang taxi "squeaked" and stopped in front of the iron gate of the park. The white words "Jinjiang Rental" on the car were a little blurry.

Wei Mu held the car door handle and moved it down, subconsciously rubbing his chest with his left hand.

"Master, your driving skills are not bad."

"It's not bad. It's been open for more than ten years."

After closing the car door, Wei Mu felt like vomiting.

Are all the veteran drivers in Shanghai so fierce?The originally 20-minute journey took 12 minutes.

The ride was bumpy and bumpy, and he almost vomited in the car.

After coming back to his senses, he looked around.

This is a park transformed from an old factory. It was originally the site of the No. 4 Textile Machinery Factory in Modu. After 2000, it was converted into a creative industry park.

This place is home to a large number of art studios.

Wei Mu walked over according to the address on his cell phone, and could vaguely see the mark of the textile machinery factory on the red brick wall.

After a while, we arrived at the place.

When he came for the interview this time, Wei Mu had already thought of his words.

Signing with Tang Dynasty is not a good choice now, but Tang Ren's TV series can be acted.

Tang Dynasty's upcoming "Legend of Sword and Fairy III" is a hit drama that aired in 2009.

No need to think about the male protagonist, it must be Brother Hu.

The slogan "No Huge, no Immortal Sword" is not just talk.

Later, "Legend of Sword and Fairy 5" was filmed, with the male protagonist Han Dongjun Nazha.

When the project was established, both of them were newcomers.

Nazha was fine, but Han Dongjun was scolded badly.

Some idiot fans clamored, "As long as the male protagonist is not Brother Hu, I won't watch Sword and Fairy"

Basically scolded from beginning to end.

After the TV series was aired, the data was okay, but unfortunately the reputation was poor, and there would be no discussion at all in a few years.

In comparison, its first two works had an astonishing subsequent impact.

Let me just say one thing, as long as Hu Ge and Liu Yifei are in the same frame in the future, there will definitely be people who love "Brother Xiaoyao and Ling'er"

In fact, there is nothing fishy between the two of them.

How old was Liu Yifei when filming "Legend of Sword and Fairy One"?

Under 17 years old, what can Lao Hu do?

In other words, what does he dare to do?

Even if she had the intention, Liu Xiaoli would not let him succeed. During the filming, this "good mother" followed her all the time and did not give anyone a chance to get close to her daughter.

There is also "Legend of Sword and Fairy III". Several heroines have gained a lot of traffic with this drama.

More than ten years later, as long as there are no announcements for these three people, they will take a photo together and post it on Weibo Moments or something, and it will be sure to be hotly searched.
